title: Text sizes
description: Fluid type in px. Steps 0, 2, 4 and 6 are the Visual direction prototype sizes; steps 1, 3 and 5 are the geometric mean of their neighbours, rounded to 2 decimals in rem (owner decision 2026-11-16); step 6 max is 144px (9rem), so step 5 max is the geometric mean of 6rem and 9rem.
